items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: You know what they call him? Verrett and Homer.

ctx.x: And we uh. Did he have any brothers or anybody else in the family that played music? No. Just Eddie.
No, just Eddie. Cause his sister, none of them didn't play no music. Just Eddie. We didn't just stay there and played on the ground. And we had a band.

learn together. So I took my lesson at a place they called Jimmy, Jimmy, we called him Jimmy Spree. Yeah, yeah. That's right. His grandmother was it that raised him? His grandmother raised him. That's the name that. You know what they call him? Verrett and Homer. I used to go there twice a week. And Jimmy taught you then on violin? Did he teach you anything on cornet too? No, no.
